ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording judged thin and lacking impact, with one reviewer calling it a poor‑sounding SBD while another gives a vague five‑star rating
ai_review.review: The consensus on the audio is mixed: one detailed critic lambastes the tape for its thin organ, missing reverb and overall lack of fullness, deeming it far inferior to Barry Glassberg’s audience recording. A second reviewer offers a brief, enthusiastic five‑star note that does not elaborate on any musical or technical details.

ai_rating.rationale: Only two reviews are present with opposite star ratings and limited detail; the negative commentary on recording quality drags the average down, while the positive five‑star comment lacks substance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review mentions no reverb, thin organ sound, lack of sustain and fullness; overall impact described as missing. Considered inferior to known audience (AUD) source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No comments about set structure or pacing were provided.
